hints.title: Feasibility Monotonicity
hints.text: If a ribbon length x can produce at least k segments, any shorter length can also produce at least k segments.

hints.title: Segment Count Formula
hints.text: A ribbon of length L produces L // x segments of length x.

hints.title: Binary Search Over Length
hints.text: Binary search candidate lengths from 1 to max(ribbons), returning the largest length with segment count >= k.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all lengths linearly from 1 to max(ribbon) takes O(n * max_ribbon) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over length converges in logarithmic time evaluating feasibility in O(n) per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs binary search on answer with sum(r // mid) >= k.
